# Word Index — Clear English Bible (completed corpus)

A complete index of every word used in the 73 books of the corpus, generated mechanically by script (`build_word_index.py`, kept beside this file) from the reader files in `individual-books/`. It is a machine-generated index: no entry was written or corrected by hand.

## Tokenization rules

- The corpus is the complete reader files, exactly as they stand, including each book's completion statement and draft-history note, and including the verse numerals as they stand in the files.
- A word (token) is a maximal run of Unicode letters and digits. An apostrophe (' or ') inside such a run counts as part of the word when it sits between two letters or digits, so "God's" and "don't" are single words; a leading or trailing apostrophe is punctuation and is stripped.
- Words are case-folded to lowercase. Every other character — whitespace, punctuation, quotation marks, dashes, colons — is a separator.
- Numbers are words: the verse and chapter numerals are entries in this index like any other word.

## Totals

- Total words (tokens) in the corpus: **903,890**
- Distinct words (vocabulary): **14,250**
- Words occurring exactly once: **4,440**

## Verification

No independent recount was supplied to this build, so no verification figure is claimed in this header.
